description: This file defines a custom exception class 'BadRequestException' for the OrangeHRM API, specifically under the V2 namespace. It extends the built-in Exception class and provides a default error message for bad requests.

classes.name: BadRequestException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing a 400 Bad Request error in the OrangeHRM API. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides a default error message.

methods.description: Constructor for the BadRequestException class that initializes the exception with a message, code, and previous exception, defaulting to 'Bad Request'.
